svg.title: Playground Classics — reusable UI templates
svg.desc: Eleven reusable design groups audited against the current five ScreenGuis. One button, editable labels and colors, optional placement guides. Repeated actions and screen states reuse these masters.

g.text: Edit each master once. Reuse it with a different label, color or value.
Resize the track; rotate for vertical lists.
Dashed boxes mark optional icon / button placements.
